High-level pricing notes (pre-demo):

- Burst capacity billing: metered extra at per-token rates; we can model this against your traffic patterns during the call.
- Private deployment: available (VPC or on-prem). Minimums vary by option — typical enterprise private starts at ~100k ARR; we can scope a narrow pilot if you want lower commitment.
